description: This file defines a generic Data Access Object (DAO) interface for handling OpenMRS data entities, providing methods for retrieving and counting persisted data with options for filtering and paging.

classes.name: OpenmrsDataDAO
classes.description: A generic interface extending OpenmrsObjectDAO for CRUD operations on OpenMRS data models. Supports retrieving all data entries, counting entries, and pagination with filtering options.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all persistent data objects, with an option to include voided records.

methods.name: getAllCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of persistent data objects, with an option to include voided records.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of persistent data objects, optionally including voided records.
